rationale.text: The case involves a clinical result message sent to a patient (a person), not a marketing message, and the only binding clause addressing delivery (U8-1-23) explicitly restricts its scope to *Marketing* Text Messages, thus excluding this scenario. No clause covers delivery to a person for clinical results.
